call_points.text: Care targets a 100% combined ratio in two years, reiterating the commitment from the last call.
Care will not give full-year growth guidance; it intends to beat the market.
Care raised ₹150 Cr equity in Q1 and ₹200 Cr sub-debt in August 2026.
RBI declined the demerger application without giving a reason; management is engaging with the regulator.
The tentative Q1FY28 demerger deadline will likely slip, management conceded.
Care's gross opex ratio was 31.2%, improving 100 bps YoY.
Religare Finvest's written-off pool is ₹350-400 Cr; recoveries are expected to taper as the legacy book dwindles.
Care Health retail business grew 37% year-on-year on a full premium basis.
Care combined ratio under Ind AS improved by 120 basis points to 101.4%.

timeline.summary: In April 2026, Religare Enterprises reported the tenure end of Anuj Gulati as MD & CEO of subsidiary Care Health Insurance.
In April 2026, Religare Enterprises announced that its material subsidiary Care Health Insurance received a rectification order reducing its AY 2022-23 tax liability to ₹86.66 Cr.
In May 2026, Religare Enterprises held its EGM to vote on shifting its registered office to Haryana and appointing Arjun Lamba as Executive Director.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,467.42 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹82.21 Cr.
Religare Enterprises approved the surrender of license and closure of its wholly owned subsidiary MIC Insurance Web Aggregator.
In May 2026, Religare Enterprises reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹8,493.84 Cr and PAT of ₹73.16 Cr.
In May 2026, Religare Enterprises filed the monitoring agency report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, showing ₹380.82 Cr utilized from the ₹1,500 Cr warrant issue.
Religare Enterprises Limited shared the earnings call recording on May 13, 2026, discussing Q4FY26 and FY26 performance at 4:00 PM IST.
In May 2026, Religare Enterprises reported Q4 and FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹8,493.84 Cr and PAT of ₹73.16 Cr.
Puran Associates Private Limited, as promoter of Religare Enterprises Limited, declared no encumbrance on 10,07,75,486 equity shares by March 31, 2026.
In June 2026, Religare Enterprises allotted 83,43,263 equity shares upon warrant conversion, raising ₹147.05 Cr.
Care Health Insurance allotted ₹150 Cr of unsecured subordinated redeemable non-convertible debentures.
